a protein that functions as a biological catalyst
a substance taken into the body that modifies or affects chemical reactions in the body

How does this adaption help the lily to survive?

makes the leaf buoyant enough to float on water
provides more space for the xylem and phloem
speeds up gas exchange between the leaf and water

options.text: The human plasmids are isolated using restriction enzymes.
Ligase is used to create sticky ends in bacterial plasmids.
Restriction enzymes are used to create sticky ends in human DNA.
